# Corpus Dedup Library

> A corpus near-deduplication and quality-filtering library built from scratch in Python with a bit-exact Rust core, using MinHash and locality-sensitive hashing, scored for precision, recall, and the fraction of document pairs compared.

Languages: Python, Rust. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/corpus-dedup-library

## Source

- [rust/src/bin/corpus-dedup.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/corpus-dedup-library/blob/main/rust/src/bin/corpus-dedup.rs): `corpus-dedup`: stream JSONL on stdin, write the deduplicated lines to stdout.
- [rust/src/cluster.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/corpus-dedup-library/blob/main/rust/src/cluster.rs): Union-find clustering of confirmed duplicate pairs; the lowest id in a cluster is kept.
- [rust/src/lib.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/corpus-dedup-library/blob/main/rust/src/lib.rs): Rust core of corpus-dedup-library: MinHash signatures, LSH banding, and clustering.
- [rust/src/lsh.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/corpus-dedup-library/blob/main/rust/src/lsh.rs): LSH banding: documents sharing any band bucket become candidate pairs.
- [rust/src/minhash.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/corpus-dedup-library/blob/main/rust/src/minhash.rs): MinHash signatures over hashed word shingles.
- [rust/src/python.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/corpus-dedup-library/blob/main/rust/src/python.rs): PyO3 bindings, built by maturin into the `corpus_dedup_rs` extension module.
- [src/corpus_dedup_library/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/corpus-dedup-library/blob/main/src/corpus_dedup_library/__init__.py): Corpus Dedup Library - MinHash and LSH near-deduplication from scratch.
- [src/corpus_dedup_library/backend.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/corpus-dedup-library/blob/main/src/corpus_dedup_library/backend.py): Optional Rust backend, used when the ``corpus_dedup_rs`` extension is installed.
- [src/corpus_dedup_library/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/corpus-dedup-library/blob/main/src/corpus_dedup_library/cli.py): Command line interface for the corpus deduplication library.
- [src/corpus_dedup_library/data.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/corpus-dedup-library/blob/main/src/corpus_dedup_library/data.py): A deterministic synthetic corpus with injected near-duplicates.
- [src/corpus_dedup_library/dedup.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/corpus-dedup-library/blob/main/src/corpus_dedup_library/dedup.py): The near-deduplication pipeline: candidates, verification, and clustering.
- [src/corpus_dedup_library/evaluation.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/corpus-dedup-library/blob/main/src/corpus_dedup_library/evaluation.py): Evaluation: near-duplicate detection quality and candidate-pair reduction.
- [src/corpus_dedup_library/lsh.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/corpus-dedup-library/blob/main/src/corpus_dedup_library/lsh.py): Locality-sensitive hashing over MinHash signatures.
- [src/corpus_dedup_library/minhash.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/corpus-dedup-library/blob/main/src/corpus_dedup_library/minhash.py): MinHash signatures over shingled text.
- [src/corpus_dedup_library/observability.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/corpus-dedup-library/blob/main/src/corpus_dedup_library/observability.py): In-process request metrics for the HTTP service (Prometheus text exposition).
- [src/corpus_dedup_library/quality.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/corpus-dedup-library/blob/main/src/corpus_dedup_library/quality.py): Heuristic quality filtering, in the spirit of large-corpus cleaning pipelines.
- [src/corpus_dedup_library/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/corpus-dedup-library/blob/main/src/corpus_dedup_library/service.py): A standard-library HTTP service for near-deduplication and quality filtering.
